text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is about to start, and
Fuji Kiseki
is uncharacteristically
antagonistic toward her
fellow racer,
Mayano Top Gun. The audience gets

fired up by the sparks flying between
them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But all this is just an act to add some
"spice" to
the race, and Mayano Top
Gun is simply playing
along with Fuji
Kiseki.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The excitement in the racecourse
reaches a
boiling point... Both of them
step proudly onto
the turf and prepare
to race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
